evidence.quote: This report outlines the intended designs and procedures involved

criteria.reasoning: Logical headings and readable prose with executive summary. Figures/tables lack numbers/titles, reference formatting broken, Wikipedia used despite prohibition, in-text citations loosely matched.

technical_issues.issue: 600 km SSO inclination stated as 87.79 deg; correct ~97.8 deg. 87.79 deg is prograde, contradicts claimed retrograde near-polar SSO and Image 3 plot.
Kourou latitude stated as 45.05 deg N; actual ~5.2 deg N. Invalidates launch-window reasoning.
RAAN 27.33 deg claimed to indicate launch facility location; RAAN does not encode launch site and value unjustified.
Mean contact claimed almost twenty minutes; table mean 580.8 s (~9.7 min), max 770 s. Overstatement ~2x.

overall: Single-satellite GBR reef monitor with plausible architecture and STK support, but marred by critical SSO inclination error, location error, and incomplete operator/files/referencing compliance.
